name: Apollo 11
hook: July 1969: the Eagle lands, Armstrong steps out, and Jeopardy asks about it ever after.

facts.label: July 20, 1969
facts.statement: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969; Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on its surface while the command module stayed in orbit.

facts.label: the Eagle
facts.statement: The Eagle was Apollo 11's lunar module; it landed in the Sea of Tranquility, and Armstrong flew it manually past a rocky crater.

facts.label: Neil Armstrong
facts.statement: Neil Armstrong was the first man on the Moon; a museum in his hometown of Wapakoneta, Ohio, honors him, and Gemini 8 nearly killed him in 1966.

facts.label: Buzz Aldrin
facts.statement: Buzz Aldrin was the second man to walk on the Moon, landing with Apollo 11 in July 1969.

facts.label: Apollo 13
facts.statement: Apollo 13 suffered an oxygen tank rupture and had to swing around the Moon without landing; Jack Swigert was the last-minute replacement.

facts.label: Apollo-Soyuz
facts.statement: In 1975 an Apollo spacecraft docked with a Soviet Soyuz in the first joint U.S.-Soviet space mission, the last flight of the Apollo program.

facts.label: Gemini
facts.statement: Apollo was preceded by Mercury and Gemini; a stuck thruster sent Armstrong's Gemini 8 spinning in 1966.
